title.en: Consistent Settings and personal agent presets
title.zh: 统一设置体验与个性化智能体预设

summary.en: Deepzora 0.0.4 unifies Settings layouts and protects unsaved edits when navigating. Create agent presets directly from the composer, choose a prompt mode, and customize their icons with colors or uploaded images. Provider branding, popup tooltips and release-note links are also corrected. The reported Windows shutdown stall remains under investigation.
summary.zh: Deepzora 0.0.4 统一设置页布局，并在切页时保护未保存的修改。可直接从输入区新建智能体预设、选择提示词模式，并用颜色或上传图片自定义图标。同时修复服务商品牌图标、弹出菜单提示和发布说明链接。已报告的 Windows 退出卡住问题仍在排查。

title.zh: 设置切页保护未保存修改

body.en: All 20 Settings pages share consistent headings, back navigation, spacing, action bars and feedback. When leaving an editor, keep editing, discard changes, or save before continuing. Failed saves retain the draft, and model dialogs apply their edits before the parent connection is saved. Installation, connection and feedback actions still require explicit submission.
body.zh: 全部 20 个设置主页统一标题、返回入口、间距、操作栏和状态反馈。离开编辑器时可继续编辑、放弃更改或保存后继续；保存失败保留草稿，模型弹窗先应用修改再保存父级连接。安装、连接和发送反馈仍需明确提交。

title.zh: 快速创建个性化智能体预设

body.en: Open New agent preset from the composer menu. Names suggest valid, collision-free IDs until you edit the ID yourself. Choose a built-in icon and color, randomize them, or upload and crop a PNG, JPEG or WebP image. The same icon appears in the editor, preset list and composer picker.
body.zh: 从输入区预设菜单直接新建智能体预设。名称会自动建议合法且不冲突的 ID，手动编辑 ID 后停止跟随名称。可选择内置图标及颜色、随机组合，或上传并裁剪 PNG、JPEG、WebP 图片；编辑器、预设列表与输入区选择器显示同一图标。

title.zh: 三种明确的预设提示词模式

body.en: Choose to extend default instructions, replace coding instructions, or provide the complete system prompt. The editor explains the selected mode and validates its required body. Runtime context moves into Advanced settings, while tool restrictions and existing prompt semantics are preserved.
body.zh: 明确选择扩展默认指令、替换编程指令或提供完整系统提示词。编辑器说明所选模式并校验必要正文；运行时上下文移入高级设置，工具限制及已有提示词语义保持兼容。

title.en: Readable Settings at smaller window sizes
title.zh: 窄窗口下的设置页更易用

body.en: Cards retain space around labels and controls, navigation stays reachable, long paths and dates wrap, and theme preview controls fit narrow windows. Loading failures now stop loading and offer retry instead of appearing as empty results.
body.zh: 卡片文字与控件保留两侧留白，导航保持可达，长路径与日期可换行，主题预览控件适配窄窗口。加载失败会停止加载并提供重试，不再伪装成空列表。

title.zh: 更容易找到 Magpie

body.en: Magpie appears third in the Add Provider catalog, after DeepSeek and OpenCode, while the remaining brands keep their relative order.
body.zh: 添加模型服务时，Magpie 位于 DeepSeek、OpenCode 之后的第三位，其他品牌的相对顺序保持不变。

title.en: Provider icons keep their brand identity
title.zh: 服务商图标保持品牌身份

body.en: Generated or renamed connections and model rows retain the preset brand instead of showing a protocol or upstream model vendor's icon. GMI Cloud and Xiaomi MiMo artwork is included; brands without artwork keep their monograms.
body.zh: 自动生成或重命名的连接及模型行保留预设品牌，不再误用协议或上游模型厂商的图标。补齐 GMI Cloud 与小米 MiMo 图标；没有图稿的品牌继续显示首字母。

title.en: Tooltips no longer cover open menus
title.zh: 提示气泡不再覆盖已展开菜单

body.en: Preset, project and session menus hide their trigger's tooltip while expanded, including delayed hover and focus callbacks. Menu content no longer reopens the trigger's help when it receives focus.
body.zh: 预设、项目和会话菜单展开时隐藏触发按钮的提示气泡，包括延迟的悬停与焦点回调；菜单内容获得焦点时也不会重新打开提示。

title.en: Release notes open the latest Desktop release
title.zh: 发布说明打开最新桌面版本

body.en: About's Open on web action and newly created heartbeat update suggestions use the latest Desktop release URL instead of an incomplete tag URL that returned 404.
body.zh: 关于页的在网页查看及新建心跳更新建议使用最新桌面版发布链接，不再打开返回 404 的不完整标签地址。

title.zh: 校验官方更新包

body.en: Desktop packages must pass Minisign integrity and provenance verification, macOS signing and notarization, and the Windows Authenticode policy for this version. Use the official download links and retain package verification when updating.
body.zh: 桌面安装包须通过 Minisign 完整性及来源验证、macOS 签名与公证，以及适用于本版本的 Windows Authenticode 策略。请使用官方下载链接，并在更新时保留安装包校验。

title.en: Update before sharing image or color presets
title.zh: 共享图片或彩色预设前先升级

body.en: Custom icons add optional icon-image and icon-color YAML fields. Update older Desktop and CLI installations before sharing these presets; older versions reject unfamiliar fields. Glyph-only presets remain compatible, and display metadata does not change runtime fingerprints or provider prompts.
body.zh: 自定义图标新增可选的 icon-image、icon-color YAML 字段。共享此类预设前请先升级旧桌面端和 CLI，旧版会拒绝未知字段。仅用内置图标的预设保持兼容，显示元数据不会改变运行时指纹或供应商提示词。

title.en: Windows remains unsigned for this release
title.zh: 本版 Windows 仍未代码签名

body.en: The maintainer explicitly approved an unsigned Windows 0.0.4 exception. These files have no Deepzora Authenticode publisher signature, so Windows may show unknown-publisher or SmartScreen warnings. Minisign integrity signatures, provenance and final-package native acceptance remain mandatory. This approval does not cover later versions.
body.zh: 维护者已明确批准 Windows 0.0.4 未签名发布例外。相关文件没有 Deepzora 的 Authenticode 发布者签名，Windows 可能显示未知发布者或 SmartScreen 提示。Minisign 完整性签名、来源验证及最终安装包原生验收仍必须完成。此批准不适用于后续版本。

title.en: Reported Windows shutdown stall remains under investigation
title.zh: Windows 退出卡住的报告仍在排查

body.en: The report of shutdown stopping at shutdown_incomplete: desktop shutdown stopped in cancelling_background remains open. This release's Settings and preset improvements do not resolve it. If affected, attach service.log and service.log.1 from %APPDATA%\Deepzora\logs to issue #126, retaining the desktop: shutdown step entries.
body.zh: 退出停在 shutdown_incomplete: desktop shutdown stopped in cancelling_background 的报告仍未关闭，本版设置和预设改进不代表已解决该问题。如遇到，请向 issue #126 附上 %APPDATA%\Deepzora\logs 下的 service.log 与 service.log.1，并保留 desktop: shutdown step 记录。

title.en: Conversation status, Magpie models and more reliable updates
title.zh: 会话状态面板、Magpie 模型与更可靠的更新

summary.en: Deepzora 0.0.3 adds a conversation status panel, Magpie gateway model discovery, per-model native search, and easier preset editing. It fixes sessions appearing disconnected, restores the conversation width setting, and improves update downloads and Settings. The bilingual official website is now available. Windows 0.0.3 remains unsigned, and the reported shutdown stall remains under investigation.
summary.zh: Deepzora 0.0.3 新增会话状态面板、Magpie 网关模型发现、按模型配置原生搜索，以及更方便的预设编辑。修复会话显示连接中断和会话宽度设置不生效的问题，并改进更新下载与设置页。中英双语官网现已上线。Windows 0.0.3 仍未代码签名，已报告的退出卡住问题仍在排查。

title.zh: 在一个面板中查看会话状态

body.en: Expand the status pill at the top right of the chat to inspect the workspace and Git changes, Goal progress, plan and todos, background commands, workflows and subagents. Read background output and child conversations, or cancel a selected subagent without stopping its parent.
body.zh: 展开聊天区右上角的状态按钮，查看工作区与 Git 变更、Goal 进度、计划与待办、后台命令、工作流和子智能体。可以查看后台输出和子会话，或取消指定子智能体而不停止父会话。

title.zh: 接入 Magpie 网关模型

body.en: A new Magpie provider preset connects to the local gateway. Adding it in Desktop fetches and enables the gateway's configured models, keeping their display names while preserving the model IDs used for routing. Start Magpie and configure its providers first.
body.zh: 新增 Magpie 服务商预设，可连接本机网关。在桌面端添加连接时会获取并启用网关中已配置的模型，显示模型名称并保留实际路由使用的模型 ID。使用前请先启动 Magpie 并配置其中的服务商。

title.zh: 按模型设置原生搜索

body.en: Edit a model to turn native search on or off for that model only. Models you leave alone inherit the connection setting. The option is available on the Anthropic and Responses protocols, and on official DeepSeek connections. Other Chat Completions connections have no native search, so it stays disabled there.
body.zh: 在编辑模型时可以只为该模型开关原生搜索，未设置的模型沿用连接级配置。Anthropic、Responses 协议和官方 DeepSeek 连接可用此选项；其他 Chat Completions 连接没有原生搜索，选项保持禁用。

title.zh: 预设工具选择器与图标

body.en: Choose built-in tools and MCP servers from a grouped, searchable list, or add custom tool names and patterns. Selected tools appear as removable chips. Choose an optional preset icon that also appears in the composer picker; card descriptions and editor hints now align consistently.
body.zh: 在可搜索的分组列表中选择内置工具和 MCP 服务，也可添加自定义工具名称与匹配模式；已选工具显示为可移除标签。预设可选配图标，并同步显示在输入区选择器中；卡片说明与编辑提示的对齐也已修复。

title.zh: 中英双语官网

body.en: The official website at https://deepzora.app now offers Chinese and English pages with desktop downloads. Release delivery verifies the R2 download mirror before updating the website's version and download links.
body.zh: 官网 https://deepzora.app 现提供中文和英文页面及桌面端下载。发布流程在验证 R2 下载镜像后，再更新官网版本和下载链接。

title.zh: 通过验证的镜像下载更新

body.en: The updater prefers the R2 mirror and falls back to GitHub when needed, verifying downloaded files against the release's expected integrity information.
body.zh: 自动更新优先使用 R2 镜像，必要时回退到 GitHub，并依据目标版本的完整性信息校验下载文件。

title.zh: 设置页使用统一界面

body.en: The sidebar, navigation and content area now share one background, separated by a single divider, and page sections no longer sit on white blocks.
body.zh: 侧边栏、导航和内容区现在使用同一背景，仅以一条分隔线区分，页面分区也不再显示为白色色块。

title.zh: 用量热力图更柔和

body.en: Days without usage now use a neutral color, so an empty heatmap no longer looks like activity.
body.zh: 没有用量的日期现在使用中性色，空白热力图不再看起来像有活动记录。

title.zh: 反馈输入框占满整行

body.en: The feedback field in Settings now spans the full row at every window width.
body.zh: 设置中的反馈输入框在任意窗口宽度下都会占满整行。

title.zh: 依赖更新

body.en: Updated Go and desktop dependencies, including `golang.org/x/net`, `modernc.org/sqlite`, Vite and KaTeX.
body.zh: 更新了 Go 和桌面端依赖，包括 `golang.org/x/net`、`modernc.org/sqlite`、Vite 和 KaTeX。

title.en: New sessions no longer disconnect every workspace
title.zh: 新会话不再导致所有工作区显示断连

body.en: Creating a session, cancelling a turn, or entering recovery no longer makes one session's incomplete runtime state mark all workspaces as disconnected and disable their inputs. The separately reported shutdown stall is not fixed by this change.
body.zh: 创建会话、取消一轮对话或进入恢复状态时，不再因单个会话的运行状态不完整而让所有工作区显示连接中断并禁用输入框。另行报告的退出卡住问题不属于本次修复范围。

title.en: Conversation width applies to the transcript
title.zh: 会话宽度设置对聊天内容生效

body.en: The standard and full-width settings now resize the conversation transcript as well as the composer. Collapsing the sidebar can widen the chat column again.
body.zh: 标准和全宽设置现在会同时调整聊天内容与输入区宽度，折叠侧边栏后聊天列也能相应变宽。

title.zh: 自动检查更新减少无效报错

body.en: Temporary network failures during startup or focus-triggered update checks no longer show an update-failed banner. Automatic checks retry after 15 minutes; checks you start manually still report failures.
body.zh: 启动或窗口重新获得焦点时，自动检查更新遇到临时网络故障不再弹出更新失败提示，并会在 15 分钟后重试；手动检查仍会报告失败。

title.en: No recovery warning during normal submission
title.zh: 正常发送时不再闪现恢复警告

body.en: Submitting a message normally no longer briefly displays a recovery warning while the session state updates.
body.zh: 正常提交消息时，会话状态更新期间不再短暂显示恢复警告。

title.en: Settings work with no tab open
title.zh: 未打开标签页时也能修改设置

body.en: Settings that rebuild the runtime no longer fail with `no active tab` when nothing is open. They now save and apply to the next tab. Removing a plugin works in the same state.
body.zh: 未打开任何内容时，需要重建运行时的设置不再报 `no active tab` 错误，而是保存后在下一个标签页生效。此状态下卸载插件同样可用。

title.en: More time for Git Bash detection
title.zh: 放宽 Git Bash 检测时间

body.en: On Windows, bash and git probes now wait up to 15 seconds instead of 3, so a slow first launch is less likely to be reported as not installed.
body.zh: Windows 上的 bash 和 git 探测现在最多等待 15 秒（原为 3 秒），首次启动较慢时更不容易被误报为未安装。

title.zh: 新增可选模型配置

body.en: `model_overrides.<model>.web_search` is optional. Existing configurations behave the same until you set it.
body.zh: `model_overrides.<model>.web_search` 为可选项。未设置时，现有配置的行为不变。

title.en: Reported Windows shutdown stall remains under investigation
title.zh: Windows 退出卡住的报告仍在排查

body.en: A Windows report describes shutdown stopping at `shutdown_incomplete: desktop shutdown stopped in cancelling_background`. The issue has not been reproduced locally and is not resolved by the session-state fix. If it occurs, attach service.log and service.log.1 from %APPDATA%\Deepzora\logs to [issue #126](https://github.com/SivanCola/deepzora/issues/126), including the `desktop: shutdown step` entries.
body.zh: 已有 Windows 报告显示退出停在 `shutdown_incomplete: desktop shutdown stopped in cancelling_background`。该问题尚未在本地复现，会话状态修复不代表已解决退出问题。如遇到，请在 [issue #126](https://github.com/SivanCola/deepzora/issues/126) 附上 %APPDATA%\Deepzora\logs 下的 service.log 与 service.log.1，保留其中的 `desktop: shutdown step` 记录。

title.zh: Windows 仍未代码签名

body.en: Windows 0.0.3 has no Deepzora Authenticode publisher signature, so Windows may show an unknown-publisher or SmartScreen warning. Desktop download and payload integrity signatures remain required. This is a version-specific exception approved by the maintainer.
body.zh: Windows 0.0.3 没有 Deepzora 的 Authenticode 发布者签名，可能出现未知发布者或 SmartScreen 提示。桌面下载及载荷完整性签名仍须校验。本例外仅限该版本，由维护者批准。

title.zh: 未验证端点上的原生搜索

body.en: Compatible endpoints that Deepzora has not verified can be opted in, but requests may fail if the endpoint does not support native search. Turn the option off for that model if this happens.
body.zh: 尚未经 Deepzora 验证的兼容端点也可以手动开启，但如果端点不支持原生搜索，请求可能失败。遇到这种情况时，请为该模型关闭此选项。

title.zh: 专注本地的桌面端与 CLI

summary.en: Deepzora 0.0.2 narrows the product to the CLI, the desktop app and ACP. SSH remote workspaces, deepzora serve and session takeover are removed. This release adds session agent presets and native attachments, keeps the sidebar current while you work, and fixes issues found in live CLI runs. Sessions created by 0.0.1 open and continue unchanged. Windows 0.0.2 is still distributed without Authenticode signing.
summary.zh: Deepzora 0.0.2 将产品收敛为 CLI、桌面端和 ACP，移除 SSH 远程工作区、deepzora serve 和会话接管。本版新增会话智能体预设与原生附件，侧边栏随工作实时更新，并修复真实 CLI 运行中发现的问题。0.0.1 创建的会话可直接打开并继续。Windows 0.0.2 仍未提供 Authenticode 代码签名。

title.zh: 会话智能体预设

body.en: Write reusable agent definitions in user or project Markdown, pick one before the first turn, and reopen a session against the latest saved definition. Tool allowlists are enforced separately from permission approval.
body.zh: 在用户或项目 Markdown 中编写可复用的智能体定义，首轮前选择，重新打开会话时使用最新保存的定义。工具白名单独立于权限审批强制执行。

title.zh: 实时更新的侧边栏

body.en: New sessions appear in the sidebar as soon as you send, and an untitled session takes its first message as its name in both the sidebar and the title bar.
body.zh: 发送后新会话立即出现在侧边栏；未命名会话在侧边栏和标题栏中都以首条消息作为名称。

title.zh: 原生附件

body.en: Reference local files natively and stream large attachments instead of pasting their contents.
body.zh: 可原生引用本地文件，大附件以流式传输，无需粘贴内容。

title.zh: 管道输入与提示词并用

body.en: `git diff | deepzora -p "review this"` now passes the piped text to the model after the prompt. A pipe that stays silent for 2 seconds is ignored, so callers that leave stdin open do not hang.
body.zh: `git diff | deepzora -p "review this"` 现在会把管道内容附在提示词之后发给模型；2 秒内无数据的管道会被忽略，保持 stdin 打开的调用方不会卡住。

title.zh: 更清晰的诊断与参数

body.en: `doctor` reports the per-project session store, the missing-key error names the `.env` file and `deepzora setup`, `run` accepts `-r` for `--resume`, and invalid `--max-steps` or `--effort` values exit with code 2.
body.zh: `doctor` 显示按项目划分的会话目录；缺少密钥时提示 `.env` 路径和 `deepzora setup`；`run` 支持 `-r` 作为 `--resume` 简写；无效的 `--max-steps` 或 `--effort` 以退出码 2 结束。

title.en: Sessions in use elsewhere open read-only
title.zh: 被占用的会话以只读方式打开

body.en: Opening a session that another Deepzora process is writing now shows its history read-only instead of failing.
body.zh: 打开正被另一个 Deepzora 进程写入的会话时，现在以只读方式显示历史，而不是打开失败。

title.en: Title bar name for new sessions
title.zh: 新会话的标题栏名称

body.en: The title bar no longer stays on "New session" after the first message is saved.
body.zh: 首条消息保存后，标题栏不再停留在“新的会话”。

title.zh: 远程与 Serve 功能已移除

body.en: SSH remote workspaces, `deepzora serve`, `deepzora remote`, `deepzora web`, `/remote`, `/takeover` and `--takeover` are gone. Leftover `[remote]` and `[serve]` config sections are ignored. Local sessions, the CLI, the desktop app and ACP are unaffected.
body.zh: SSH 远程工作区、`deepzora serve`、`deepzora remote`、`deepzora web`、`/remote`、`/takeover` 和 `--takeover` 已移除。配置中残留的 `[remote]`、`[serve]` 段会被忽略。本地会话、CLI、桌面端和 ACP 不受影响。

title.zh: 0.0.1 会话可直接沿用

body.en: Sessions and desktop data created by 0.0.1 open, show their history and continue in 0.0.2 without migration.
body.zh: 0.0.1 创建的会话和桌面数据无需迁移，在 0.0.2 中可直接打开、查看历史并继续对话。

title.zh: Windows 仍未代码签名

body.en: Windows 0.0.2 has no Deepzora Authenticode publisher signature, so Windows may show an unknown-publisher or SmartScreen warning. Desktop download and payload integrity signatures remain required. This is a version-specific exception approved by the maintainer.
body.zh: Windows 0.0.2 没有 Deepzora 的 Authenticode 发布者签名，可能出现未知发布者或 SmartScreen 提示。桌面下载及载荷完整性签名仍须校验。本例外仅限该版本，由维护者批准。

title.zh: 首个公开版本

summary.en: The first Deepzora baseline brings the current CLI, Electron desktop and Serve service into independent release channels, with documented signing and privacy policies. Windows v0.0.1 is distributed without Authenticode signing.
summary.zh: Deepzora 首版提供当前 CLI、Electron 桌面端和 Serve 服务，采用独立发布渠道并公开签名与隐私政策。Windows v0.0.1 暂不提供 Authenticode 代码签名。

title.zh: 统一当前契约

body.en: Current session storage, formal-session composer state, scoped command receipts, and the Deepzora remote baseline are the supported formats.
body.zh: 仅支持当前会话存储、正式会话输入状态、带作用域回执的命令和 Deepzora 远程基线。

title.zh: Windows 首版暂未代码签名

body.en: Windows v0.0.1 has no Deepzora Authenticode publisher signature, so Windows may display an unknown-publisher or SmartScreen warning. Desktop download and payload integrity signatures remain required. This is a version-specific exception; SignPath approval is pending.
body.zh: Windows v0.0.1 没有 Deepzora 的 Authenticode 发布者签名，可能出现未知发布者或 SmartScreen 提示。桌面下载及载荷完整性签名仍须校验。本次例外仅限该版本，SignPath 授权仍待审核。

title.zh: 仅支持当前数据格式
